family_name: Higgins Insulation Higgins Foil Breather Medium Duty

spec.description:
Foil Wall Wrap Breather is a medium-duty, five-layer reflective
foil wall insulation sarking with bright aluminum foil tested to 97%
reflectivity adhered to one side. When installed with an adjacent still air gap
of at least 20mm, it creates an effective radiant heat barrier while its
micro-perforations permit moisture vapor to breathe through, reducing
condensation risks in external wall cavities. The substrate is constructed from
ultra-violet stabilized woven polypropylene with anti-oxidants and corona
treatment, providing superior tear resistance on Australian building sites.
features:
Five-layer composite construction with UV-stabilized woven
polypropylene substrate

Bright aluminum foil facing tested to 97%
reflectivity

Micro-perforated breather design allows trapped water vapor to
escape the wall cavity

Medium Duty classification providing superior puncture
and tear resistance

Corona-treated substrate ensures superior adhesive
lamination strength

Acts as a weather barrier protecting frames from
wind-driven rain and dust

Manufactured in Australia to comply with Australian
fire standard AS 1530

Large roll size (1350mm x 60m) covering 81 m² with
minimal joins

install:
Roll out
horizontally on the exterior face of timber or steel wall framing studs starting
from the bottom plate

Fasten with broad-headed galvanized clouts or staples
at maximum 300mm centers to studs and plates

Overlap upper sheets over lower
sheets by at least 150mm to ensure water shedding

Ensure a minimum 20mm still
air space is maintained adjacent to the reflective foil face

Tape all
horizontal and vertical joins with reinforced foil tape to maximize air
sealing

Fix neatly around window and door openings prior to installing
joinery flashings

Ensure a drained and ventilated cavity exists between the
wrap and exterior cladding
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall
construction is brick veneer or lightweight cladding in climate zones where
breather foil is recommended

Verify roll coverage (81m² per roll) allows
for 150mm overlaps

Confirm minimum 20mm air gap can be maintained in the wall
assembly
Order matching reinforced aluminum joining tape
limitations: Not recommended for roof applications (designed specifically for walls)

Not suitable for cold climate zones where non-perforated Class 4 spunbond
membranes are required by the NCC

Protect from direct prolonged weather
exposure prior to cladding installation

Insulation product warranty

retrieval.rag_summary:
Higgins Insulation Higgins Foil Breather Medium Duty is a five-layer reflective
foil wall sarking membrane measuring 1350mm x 60m (81 m² per roll). Combining a
UV-stabilized woven polypropylene core with a 97% reflective aluminum face and
microscopic breathability perforations, it blocks radiant heat while allowing
cavity moisture vapor to escape. Tear-resistant and compliant with AS/NZS 4200.1
and AS 1530, it delivers durable weather protection and thermal air-gap
resistance across external residential and shed walls.
